answer: Identity bonds that decay block bulk forgery. Each agent posts a $40 bond losing 5% each idle epoch, so a fake drains away. Like water seeping through karst, fakes cannot be plugged cheaply: 1,000 identities cost $40,000 up front and lose over $16,000 in ten idle epochs. Honest agents in the meadow renew by work at no extra cost, paying once for undiluted rewards. This is no fable: decay is automatic, so forgery costs more than it harvests.
